input.content: Pattern: idempotent-apply gated on a one-shot status flag drops edited values on retry. Code applied values only when record["status"]=="pending" and flipped it to "applied" before the receipt/commit step. When the commit fails after apply (documented recovery boundary), the record stays "applied"; a retry with EDITED values then skips apply entirely, so the latest submitted values never take effect even though the contract promises "retry with the same ID and edited values; success means the latest submitted values are active." Also: values were stored only at record creation (dict(values) in the initial record) and re-apply used record["values"], so the function ignores the `values` argument on every call after the first for that key. Rule: when the contract says the latest submitted values win on retry, re-apply the freshly-supplied values on each attempt until the operation is COMPLETED (not merely "applied"); don't gate re-apply on an intermediate pre-commit status.
